svg.title: ULTRA-SATISFACTORY: power-on self test
svg.desc: A 1990s PC power-on screen for ULTRA-SATISFACTORY, an unofficial companion app for the game Satisfactory. Counters run up to 140 items, 211 recipes and 477 buildings, the three tabs OBJECTIVES, ITEMS and BUILDINGS are detected, and the prompts give the commands that start the app and its live address.
